business.name: X-traordinary Development
business.author: Xavier Thurman
business.location: Minneapolis, MN and Miami, FL (clients across the US)
business.description: The development team for companies that don't have one. A Black-owned custom software and AI studio building AI-native software for mid-sized companies (200 to 2,000 people) in non-tech industries that have an IT leader but no developers: assistants over company documents, research feeds, document generation, workflow automation with a person in the loop, integrations and dashboards, internal applications. Everything is built inside the client's own Microsoft and Azure environment and belongs to the client. Offers: a two-week AI-Native Assessment and first build, a retained development function (Run / Build / Advise), and fixed-price projects. We no longer build websites.

audience: IT Directors, CIOs, COOs, CFOs and owners at mid-sized companies (200 to 2,000 employees) in engineering and construction, agriculture and co-ops, manufacturing, distribution and logistics, professional services and regional healthcare administration, who have no in-house developers and are deciding what to do about custom software and AI. They are practical, budget-conscious, skeptical of hype, and want to look capable in their own leadership meetings.
tone: Plain English, direct, specific, a little dry, never salesy. Like a senior developer explaining something to a smart executive over coffee. Short paragraphs. Numbers instead of adjectives. One idea per section. Honest about trade-offs, including when the answer is 'you don't need us' or 'don't build this yet'. Never hype, never clickbait, no exclamation points, no emoji.
approvedFacts: Based in Minneapolis, MN and Miami, FL; works with clients across the US.
Black-owned business founded and led by Xavier Thurman.
Builds custom software and AI for mid-sized companies (200 to 2,000 people) that have no in-house developers.
Everything is built inside the client's own Microsoft 365 and Azure environment; the client owns the code, the data and the environment; nothing trains anyone's model.
Three offers: a two-week AI-Native Assessment and first build (fixed price, 4 to 6 weeks); a retained development function (Run / Build / Advise) on a 12-month term; fixed-price projects.
Stack: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, SharePoint, .NET/C#, React/Next.js, Python, SQL Server/PostgreSQL.
Enterprise engineering experience on internal applications at U.S. Bank and CHS Inc.

Currently the entire development function for a 1,000-person Midwest engineering firm, including an AI research-and-document platform in the firm's Azure tenant. Refer to it only as 'a 1,000-person Midwest engineering firm'; never name the firm.
Shipped products of our own include GridLink (a procurement platform) and Nouri (a coaching app).
neverClaim: Do not state our prices as facts inside a blog post beyond 'a fixed-price assessment' and 'a monthly retainer'; the exact figures live on the services page.
Do not invent statistics, percentages, survey results, or study citations. If a number is needed, phrase it as a general observation without a figure.

Do not name clients, awards, certifications, partners, or team members other than those in approvedFacts. Never name the engineering firm, and never describe its funding or proposal work in a way that could be sold to another engineering firm.
Do not make guarantees about rankings, revenue, or results.
Do not mention competitors by name.
Do not write about websites, web design, page builders, small businesses, contractors or '$399'. That audience and offer are retired.
Banned words: unlock, transform, cutting-edge, synergy, game-changer, leverage, supercharge, 10x, 'in today's fast-paced world', 'AI-powered' as a selling point.
